verdict.rationale: A direct probe of help.figma.com/llms.txt returned HTTP 404, and no evidence shows Figma Make publishing agent-oriented docs that an external agent could be pointed at. Make's own ability to fetch URLs or connect via MCP is a different capability and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
